text:
55 分钟：右路送进来，扎伊茨门前推射。
Fifty-five. In from the right, Zajc finishes.

61 分钟：任意球，萨迪克门前头球。
Sixty-one. Free kick, Sadık heads it in.

VAR 查了犯规，进球有效。
VAR checks for a foul. The goal stands.

看这脚解围——根本没解远。
Watch the clearance. It's only half cleared.

哈桑·阿里插上来，没人上去逼他。
Hasan Ali arrives. Nobody steps out.

停球、起脚，不到一秒。
Under a second to set it, and hit it.

禁区外一脚。三比三。
From outside the box. Three, three.

两球都在门前，最后一球是远射。
Two from close range. The last one, from distance.
